summary: Compact brushed DC motor controller: a flat rectangular PCB body in clear heat-shrink, with a small round spacer/tab at one end that has a 4 mm through hole for mounting. Wire leads and connectors extend from both ends but are excluded from the bounds.

mountingSurfaces.description: Underside of the round mounting spacer at the tab end, which surrounds the 4 mm through hole and sits flush against a mounting plate.

notes: Dimensions come from the printed drawing. Body length is 28.5 mm, body width is 15.5 mm, and the 4 mm hole center is 35.45 mm from the body's far end. The scale is about 8 px/mm. The spacer extends about 4.9 mm beyond the hole center, so I estimated overall length as 35.45 + 4.9 ≈ 40.3 mm. The 5.6 mm label appears to be the spacer height. The body sits slightly above the spacer, so I estimated total thickness at about 6.6 mm. That value and the hole's z position are scaled from the drawing, not printed. The hole looks open in the views, so I recorded it as through. The 150 mm wire leads and the connectors (XT30, 3.5 mm bullets, servo-style signal header) are excluded from the bounds. The box is centered on the part at the origin.
